question: Which weather stations in Washington State recorded more than 150 rainy days in 2023 but fewer rainy days compared to 2022? Defining a “rainy day” as one having precipitation greater than zero millimeters and not equal to 99.99. Only include stations with valid precipitation data.
sql:
WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, g.wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  WHERE g.stn IN (SELECT usaf FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` WHERE state = 'WA')
    AND g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, g.wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  WHERE g.stn IN (SELECT usaf FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` WHERE state = 'WA')
    AND g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
)
SELECT 
  ws.name,
  ws.usaf,
  ws.wban,
  r23.rainy_days_2023,
  r22.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 r23
JOIN rainy_2022 r22 ON r23.stn = r22.stn AND r23.wban = r22.wban
JOIN wa_stations ws ON r23.stn = ws.usaf AND r23.wban = ws.wban
WHERE r23.rainy_days_2023 > 150
  AND r23.rainy_days_2023 < r22.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY r23.rainy_days_2023 DESC

columns:
  stn  STRING  -- Cloud - GSOD NOAA
  wban  STRING  -- WBAN number where applicable--this is the historical "Weather Bureau Air Force Navy" number - with WBAN being the acronym
  date  DATE  -- Date of the weather observations
  year  STRING  -- The year
  mo  STRING  -- The month
  da  STRING  -- The day
  temp  FLOAT64  -- Mean temperature for the day in degrees Fahrenheit to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_temp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean temperature
  dewp  FLOAT64  -- Mean dew point for the day in degreesm Fahrenheit to tenths.  Missing = 9999.9
  count_dewp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean dew point
  slp  FLOAT64  -- Mean sea level pressure for the day in millibars to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_slp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean sea level pressure
  stp  FLOAT64  -- Mean station pressure for the day in millibars to tenths. Missing = 9999.9
  count_stp  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean station pressure
  visib  FLOAT64  -- Mean visibility for the day in miles to tenths.  Missing = 999.9
  count_visib  INT64  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean visibility
  wdsp  STRING  -- Mean wind speed for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  count_wdsp  STRING  -- Number of observations used in calculating mean wind speed
  mxpsd  STRING  -- Maximum sustained wind speed reported for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  gust  FLOAT64  -- Maximum wind gust reported for the day in knots to tenths. Missing = 999.9
  max  FLOAT64  -- Maximum temperature reported during the day in Fahrenheit to tenths--time of max temp report varies by country and region, so this will sometimes not be the max for the calendar day. Missing = 9999.9
  flag_max  STRING  -- Blank indicates max temp was taken from the explicit max temp report and not from the 'hourly' data. * indicates max temp was  derived from the hourly data (i.e., highest hourly or synoptic-reported temperature)
  min  FLOAT64  -- Minimum temperature reported during the day in Fahrenheit to tenths--time of min temp report varies by country and region, so this will sometimes not be the min for the calendar day. Missing = 9999.9
  flag_min  STRING  -- Blank indicates min temp was taken from the explicit min temp report and not from the 'hourly' data. * indicates min temp was derived from the hourly data (i.e., lowest hourly or synoptic-reported temperature)
  prcp  FLOAT64  -- Total precipitation (rain and/or melted snow) reported during the day in inches and hundredths; will usually not end with the midnight observation--i.e., may include latter part of previous day.  .00 indicates no measurable precipitation (includes a trace). Missing = 99.99 Note: Many stations do not report '0' on days with no precipitation--therefore, '99.99' will often appear on these days. Also, for example, a station may only report a 6-hour amount for the period during which rain fell. See Flag field for source of data
  flag_prcp  STRING  -- A = 1 report of 6-hour precipitation amount B = Summation of 2 reports of 6-hour precipitation amount C = Summation of 3 reports of 6-hour precipitation amount D = Summation of 4 reports of 6-hour precipitation amount E = 1 report of 12-hour precipitation amount F = Summation of 2 reports of 12-hour precipitation amount G = 1 report of 24-hour precipitation amount H = Station reported '0' as the amount for the day (eg, from 6-hour reports), but also reported at least one occurrence of precipitation in hourly observations--this could indicate a trace occurred, but should be considered as incomplete data for the day. I = Station did not report any precip data for the day and did not report any occurrences of precipitation in its hourly observations--it's still possible that precip occurred but was not reported
  sndp  FLOAT64  -- Snow depth in inches to tenths--last report for the day if reported more thanonce. Missing = 999.9 Note: Most stations do not report '0' ondays with no snow on the ground--therefore, '999.9' will often appear on these days
  fog  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
  rain_drizzle  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
  snow_ice_pellets  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
  hail  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
  thunder  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
  tornado_funnel_cloud  STRING  -- Indicators (1 = yes, 0 = no/not reported) for the occurrence during the day
